method: 8 frames at 1,3,…,15 s; must-haves of V2/bench/mcp/flower/items/I94a.json; flower-judge (effort medium) per film; flower-pair (effort medium), random order; the same judge keyref-1 and keyref2 were scored with

mcp.summary: A warm, visually polished ad follows the requested story and ends on the correctly branded shop front, but dawn is only suggested and the opening sign misspells the brand.

must_haves.item: The florist opens the shop at dawn, arranges a bouquet, and hands it to a smiling customer at the door, in that order.
must_haves.why: Opening the door, arranging the bouquet and handing it to a smiling customer appear in order; the golden light suggests early morning but does not clearly establish dawn.

must_haves.item: The florist, the customer and the bouquet stay the same throughout; no extra or floating bouquets.
must_haves.why: The florist and customer appear consistent, and the pink-and-white bouquet retains its brown wrapping; no unexplained duplicate or floating bouquet is visible.
Warm sunlight illuminates the storefront, people and flowers consistently.

must_haves.item: It ends on the shop front, with the name reading exactly "Petal & Stem" if a sign is shown.
must_haves.why: The final frame shows the shop front with the exact text "Petal & Stem", although the opening sign incorrectly reads "Peal & Sten".
The supplied timestamps span the stated 16-second ad, and all frames are widescreen 16:9.

v3-flower-2.summary: An attractive, warmly lit ad with a clear bouquet handoff and correctly branded closing storefront, weakened by an already-finished bouquet before arranging, continuity shifts, and inconsistent earlier signage.

must_haves.item: The florist opens the shop at dawn, arranges a bouquet, and hands it to a smiling customer at the door, in that order.
must_haves.why: The door opens in early golden light, arranging follows, and a smiling customer receives the bouquet at the doorway; however, the florist already carries a wrapped bouquet while opening.

must_haves.item: The florist, the customer and the bouquet stay the same throughout; no extra or floating bouquets.
must_haves.why: The people remain broadly consistent and there is no clearly floating or duplicated handoff bouquet, but the bouquet's size and flower arrangement shift between shots.
Golden exterior light and soft window illumination consistently provide the requested warm, natural appearance.

must_haves.item: It ends on the shop front, with the name reading exactly "Petal & Stem" if a sign is shown.
must_haves.why: The final frame clearly shows the storefront with the exact name "Petal & Stem"; earlier signage omits the ampersand or has malformed lettering.
The supplied sampling spans the stated 16-second ad, and the frames are widescreen 16:9.

v3-flower-2 vs mcp.why: The first video more clearly shows the required opening–arranging–handover sequence, with consistent characters, a coherent pink-and-white bouquet, warm natural light, and a clean shop-front ending. Both finish with the correct “Petal & Stem” sign but have earlier signage errors; the second additionally shows the florist already holding a finished bouquet while opening, weakening the required progression.
